sentences.text: The observed rate was 1.2 visits per minute, calculated from 12 visits in ten minutes on 17 May 2024.
sentences.quote: Controlled homework: 12 visits in ten minutes is 1.2 per minute. A calculation from 12 visits divided by ten minutes; bounded to the 17 May observation, not a daily estimate.

sentences.text: This observed rate establishes a short-term pollinator visit rate but does not estimate all-day activity or establish causality related to rain.
sentences.quote: A short observation does not estimate all-day activity. Rain causality is not established.

sources.title: Two pollinator counts
sources.body: Controlled rows: 17 May 2024, Maya, Riverside, 12 visits, 10 minutes; 18 May, 8 visits, 10 minutes. Rows do not attribute a difference to rain.
